en: I like workin' the sideshow. They're, uh... they're my people, y'know?
You are about to see something rare and wonderful!
It's time to show people who I really am.
The secret was gonna get out sooner or later.
Even in a world where magic surrounds us, skeptics abound.
Folks can hear the Jersey Devil perform in a comedy club and go along with it, but I tell 'em that I'm a unicorn, and everyone acts like I'm the biggest carny in the world!
I can't spend all my time at the sideshow.
Coney is safe... comfortable... but I've outgrown it... and fear can't be the only thing keeping me there.
If you need my help, I'll be there.
I've lived in the shadows my whole life, and I'm tired of it.
I'm not a one-trick pony!.. I got like four. Five if you count the one where I get an injured audience member not to sue!
I'm working on a new part of my act where I wreathe one of my audience member in ethereal flame. Haven't figured out how to do it without immolating someone yet, but I'm close. Probably.
Look, I got three matinees, five evening shows, and a private performance for a divorced dad that wants to buy his kids love.
Don't feel like I'm ready to face the world today, you know?
I've been doing a lot of thinking, and I got a good thing going on Coney. Why risk it?
I don't think it's exactly safe to be outside.
I think I'll stay with the rest of the carnies.
I don't want to hurt anyone.
I'm afraid of what'll happen if I go out there...
He should've never taken out a marker.
I know, I know. I tried to tell him, but you know Lenny, he's always going to Lenny.
It's kind of you to help him.
You goin' to the game on Friday?
Not really making plans this week. Figured I'd see if I survived today first.
I thought unicorns were supposed to be positive?
We're also supposed to be found in the woods, but I wouldn't go camping if you paid me.
I should have never told you about that.
I risk my life 4 times a night on the weekends. I'm pretty good.
I don't need advice from someone who glues a horn on their head.
That's what I know you do.
You're not like the other Blackmore Kids.
Of course I'm not. I'm better than them.
Nevermind. You're just like the other Blackmore kids.
I've never seen an 18-year-old look so serious.
Most 18-year-olds aren't about to summon an Elder God.
That's fair, but I bet you'd look the same if you were at the circus.
I'd never waste my time going to the circus.
No. I'm setting myself up to enjoy it.
I work with some pretty big Lash fans.
How would you like this to work?
If you see someone chased by a Glitter Ball, knock 'em into their friends.
You know, you and your maker should come to the show sometime. I can get you free tickets!
Well, that sounds lovely. I'm not sure Miss Shelly's health would allow it, though.
I mean, after today, her health's not supposed to be an issue, right?
That's true. I-I'm just tryna be polite.
I know people who'd pay a lot of money for that horn of yours.
I'm just trying to make conversation, no need to be rude.
I don't know how you do it...
It didn't come naturally. It took a lotta practice.
Oh- I'm not talking about your act, I'm talking about you coming home covered in glitter, it's wretched stuff.
Nice to meet you! So, what do you do?
Wine tasting. I'm working on my sommelier certification.
Ya know... I got a soft spot for carnie folk.
Yeah. There's somethin' refreshin' about humans being unapologetic for what they are. Normally, there's just so much...
I was gonna say artifice, but you cut right to the heart of it.
You plannin' on killin' me after the ritual so you can find out what unicorn blood tastes like?
No... I'm plannin' on killin' you after the ritual because I know what unicorn blood tastes like.
Okay, hear me out: What if... I just give ya blood.
Ehh, it's a lot less fun for me.

I get that! But here's the thing: We're hard to come by. If ya kill me, you don't know if you'll ever see a unicorn again! If ya let me live, you can come back whenever you want the novelty. Also, you get the added bonus not havin' half your face burned off.
I don't think anyone can be ready for somethin' like this. All I know is that my friend needs me, and I'll do anythin' I can to help him.
Stay close to me, Celeste, I'll keep you safe.
Very chivalrous, Professor. Hope the other guys are takin' notes.
What you're doing is very romantic, Professor, but I'm pretty sure your wife is more concerned with you being safe than she is about the state of your body.
I'm sure she would say that...
It's been years. She deserves a husband... with a heart she can feel, and a face she can see light up when she walks in the room.
Judgin' by the looks of the other people helpin' out the Patron... I'm glad I'm with you.
Some definitely appear more welcoming than others.
Us well-adjusted people need to stick together.
Ever thought about leaving home for the circus?
My parents have penthouse in midtown. What do you think?
Your jacket would be cooler without the fringe.
You'd be cooler without the attitude.
Don't see that changing anytime soon.
I am. You look like a sad bastard.
So you brought a bow, huh?
You're holding a baton and you're critiquing me?
Because my friend needs help. How about you?
That tie looks cute on you.
I don't usually get compliments on the uniform.
I call it like I see it.
You should come by the sideshow sometime.
I see enough knife throwing in my 9 to 5.
More than I expected, but less than I probably should be.
I don't know if it's reasonable... but it's honest.
You really know how to pull off the whole "cop on the edge" thing.
Yeah, I'm not really sure what to say to that.
Well, if I were you, I'd take the compliment and ask to buy me a drink later.
You hate the city, don't you?
I don't think I've seen you crack a smile all day.
That's got nothin' to do with the fact that this city is the worst.
You sure? It would really pop with that cowboy hat.
You don't know what you're missin'.
Well... let's give our boy a hand.
Good! You should swing by next weekend and say hi to the boys.
Assuming we get through the ritual, that sounds great.
Ah, he's nervous about the bar.
No. If he did, he'd be worried about me, and that'd be worse.
I... don't suppose it would make a difference if I said "please"?
Is it true your show has a camel with human hands?
I know you like to stay mobile, but... if there's ever an opportunity for the two of us to trap two of them in an ice dome...
We're sure as hell gonna try.
My life is in the hands of a circus freak... wonderful.
Yeah, well, maybe your life would be handled with a little more care if you didn't insult me.
Very well: Your jacket isn't heinous. There. You just got a compliment.
Anytime you wanna talk... The Lash will be here for you.
Your outfit was great at Ren Faire!
Oh, you had this whole gothic masquerade thing goin' o-
You don't have to spend your life hiding in a circus.
Hey Paradox? If this goes bad, you think you could steal someone's soul back for me?
I've never done something like that before.
I don't know, but God do I love a challenge.
Don't you dare throw this because you want to grow professionally!
No no no: I'm not tanking anythin', don't worry. But if it all goes bad, I'd love to help... if only for the novelty.
I don't remember you bein' in the audience.
Why does everybody think I walk around in this thing?
You know, you'd make a great second-story man.
Basically a fancy name for cat burglar.
I don't wanna steal from people.
Oh. You'd get over that real fast.
I don't think I wanna get over that.
I'm just saying, if you ever want a career change... I can introduce you to people.
Finally comin' out of the sewer, I see?
Maybe not forever... but you could have hid a lot longer.
I'm ready to face my father.
You had it good with Mo and Krill.
It'll be fine. Nothing's gonna change.
Don't tell me where I'm supposed to be.
You don't have to babysit me.
Not everything's about you, Arin. I got my own problems, and keeping your mole dad happy ain't one of 'em.
Hey little guy, what's your name?
Are you really a unicorn? Cause you look like a unicorn.
I dunno. No one's told me a secret.
Well, I don't know I can tell ya then.
If you can't find your way home, you can stay with me for a while.
Yeah! Folks like us need to stick together.
You mask your power in a circus sideshow. It's pathetic!
I'm hiding from federal agents, not trying to be queen in a kingdom of misfits!
Aw, don't be hard on yourself. People's morality always crumbles in the face of self-interest.
Did I see you fight in the Bear Pit?
Really? 'Cause you totally look like someone that would lose to Lash.
What's it like working with Gary Talon?
I think I'd know the name of the man who saved my life.
Hm. Guess he just really looks like a Gary.
You know, our last werewolf retired. We have an openin'.
So you could apply for the job!
You think I want to work in a side show?
What are ya doing after the ritual?
Well, don't we look like trouble?
I look like trouble. You look like a fairytale princess takin' a smoke break.
We're about be shot at, and you're dressed like you just got off a shift at the circus. So yes. I have concerns.
It's the sideshow, but close enough.
You've seen what you look like, right?
Do you always make judgements on appearances?
I mean, you're either gonna start screamin' Latin and shootin' people, or you're gonna do a burlesque act. And somethin' tells me that cassock ain't tear-away.
Lord willing, you'll survive and get to hear 'em.
Ya know you don't have to be so miserable all the time.
I don't need advice from someone who knows nothing of misery.
Lady... you don't know what the hell you're talkin' about.
You got a helluva gimmick. If you ever wanted to stop murderin' people and go straight, I bet I could get you a job.
I'm not a dancing bear, Celeste. I have goals.
Killing everyone with the last name "Hathorne" isn't a goal. It's an obsession.
You make it sound so simple. A lot of them changed their name after they got married.
I don't know how you put on a fake smile for strangers every day.
What can I say? I'm magical.
Hey, Celeste! You wanna be sister wives?
Not yet, but the man of my dreams is right around the corner! I'm just sayin', you could be part of it.
Heard Lenny really stepped in it!
Okay, well either you help out your friend, or there's one less person I owe money to, so either way, it's a win-win for us.
No, I'm only happy with one of those outcomes.
I thought you were supposed to be like a positive person, C.
Hey Celeste, do you mind if I lay low at the sideshow until the heat's off me?
I mean, I don't have an exhaustive list.
Are the cops on the list?
I just want you to know that I tried to warn your friend.
You can't help that guy! Lenny's always gonn-
Why do you care? You got your money.
He's a good guy; helping you helps him.
He's good! Thinks I'm stupid for doin' this.
Oh, we'll live! Probably live... I- I think we'll live.
I had to move the front row back a little after one too many incidents with this.
Thing's are gonna get a little spicy.
This is so much better than boring fire!
When in doubt: breathe a little fire.
I feel bad for the normies that can't breathe fire.
I haven't had to call the fire department in a while, so I think I'm getting the hang of it!
This used to be my closer at the kids' birthday parties, until Julia McClomsky and her lawsuits came along.
I know how to protect myself!
I'll do what I have to!
I'm not gonna let you kill me!
What's life without a little danger?
The reward is worth the risk.
My team is gonna put on a show!
Hope folks are ready to make the most of this.
Either it'll keep me alive, or it'll hurt my enemies. I don't care which.
Riskin' your life can be exhilarating!
We gotta get in, do some damage, and get out!
Time to put on a show!
If I wanna win... I have to be willing to cut loose.
Now this is how ya end a show.
I can't be afraid of who I am and what I can do.
There's gonna be no turning back.
Nothin' subtle about what's about to happen.
Well... hiding my nature had a good run.
Let's see 'em say I glue a horn to my head now!
I'm willin' to do whatever it takes to win.
They're about to see something unforgettable.
These are the mysteries of my people.
I am not divine... but I am powerful.
This part of the act kills!
I won't let you down, Lenny.
They won't be able to hide.
I ain't runnin' out of these anytime soon!
Lemme show you who I really am.
Who's ready to see some unicorn shit?!
I'm ready to unleash my power!
The light is ready to shine!
I'm ready to put on a light show!
This should keep 'em on their toes.
[Chuckle] who's ready for a little mischief?
I've been practicing this a lot, so I hope it works.
I love watching this bounce between people!
This is for the audience participation part of the act.
This should cause a little chaos!
I'll do as much damage as I can.
Broke a whole lotta friends' things practicing this.
I used to be a regular at the glassblowers convention! The moment I added this to the set, they stopped inviting me back.
I took this outta my routine after causing too many concussions, but... seems like a good time to dust it off!
Keep your eye on the ball, boys and girls.
Hope this goes as well as rehearsal...
Guess we're gonna see what happens.
The more of them, the better.
I'll hit as many as I can.
I'll hit as many as I can!
I don't wanna have to hurt you.
I wish it didn't have to be this way...
I'll always stand up for my people!
You think you can bully me?
You really thought this would be easy, didn't you?
They may have more money than me, but I got more talent.
You didn't think I forgot about earlier, did you?
We make for one hell of an act!
I'm the greatest act on Coney!
I'm not even warmed up yet!
You think this is scary? Just wait for the grand finale.
I won't let you stop me.
It's amazin' what someone is capable of, isn't it?
You guys might wanna give up and save us all some time.
This is who I was meant to be.
I can only hide what I am for so long.
I'm ready to accept my destiny!
I'll take on all of you!
They won't be feeling too good now.
The second show will be better than the first.
They won't see me until it's too late.
Let's see 'em use their abilities now!
Can't forget to train my powers.
I should train when I can.
I should go by the store.
I can buy a new gimmick at the shop!
I have enough for somethin' new.
I wonder what I can buy now?
I need to see what they have at the Curiosity Shop.
I can get something new at the Curiosity Shop!
Nothin' I can't afford at the shop.
Can't forget to swing by the store.
You'll have to try harder than that.
Don't leave those souls lyin' around!
Should pick up those souls before someone else does.
No point in lettin' 'em just lie there.
The objective is taken care of!
We're closer to completing the ritual!
Come back again, buddy! I'll be waiting.
They'll be back, and I'll need to be ready.
Only a matter of time before they come back for revenge.
I was really pushin' my luck there.
Things are gettin' a little intense out there!
I think I liked it better at the sideshow.
I got a bad feelin' out here...
I might wanna get back to my friends...
I'm feelin' a little exposed out here.
Not gonna lie, this is a little stressful.
I'm used to workin' when I'm nervous.
I don't like the odds here.
This isn't going to go well...
Great job!.. now what do we do?
Be careful, they have the Rejuvenator!
Damn it! They have the Rejuv!
This is our chance to summon the Patron!
You're just wastin' bullets on them!
The secret was gonna get out sooner or later.
Feel like my act is about to get a lot more dangerous.
So, you guys go to Coney a lot?
I have a good feelin' about this.
I finally get to treat the hecklers the way they deserve.
We all have our parts to play.
Wanna go to the sideshow afterwards?
Thanks so much for your help!
I couldn't have done it without you.
They can't be happy about that.
I don't know what I'd do without ya, professor.
The old man's still got it!
Don't know what I'd do without ya, Grey Talon.
I could watch her dance all day.
Glad the Sandman's workin' with us.
That lady's throwin' knives better than Lenny!
We make a good team, Infernus.
We're makin' this look easy, aren't we, Ivy?
Lash just stomped the hell out of 'em!
Cuttin' it a little close, McGinnis.
Glad you have my back, McGinnis.
Now that guy knows how to use a knife!
Jeez, Shiv, leave some for the rest of us!
Oh man, they never saw that comin'.
[Sigh] this has to be great for the skin.
They were never gonna be able to hide from her.
That book was always gonna lead ya to your death, Abrams.
You weren't meant to hold that Tome, Abrams!
I'm not gonna be your punching bag, Abrams.
Your family can't bail you outta this, kid.
You're not grabbin' my friends, Bebop.
The scrap golem is out of commission.
I'm sorry about Ms. Shelly, Bebop.
He was a good son... makes me feel kind of bad.
My light show's a little better.
Ya just gonna stand there, Bebop?
Not a great plan, tin man.
Go complain to someone else, Billy.
I know that she tried to kill me, but she sounds so fancy! I kinda love it.
You're not takin' my horn, Calico!
It's not gonna be the last time she tries to kill me.
I don't know what the hell that guy is, but he's no doorman.
I had to stop the Doorman.
That guy was such a pain in the ass.
He would kill us all if he could...
You're not feedin' off my friends, Drifter.
At least we don't need to worry about a black hole for a little bit.
I wish I could help you get your body back, Dynamo, but... I can't let you win.
He seemed like a positive person.
Look out for the black hole!
Sister, go back to your homeroom!
That girl's in way over her head.
It's for your own good, Graves.
Why are you hunting me, Grey Talon?
Why is the old man trying to kill me?
We're in Manhattan, who uses a bow?!
I don't want any trouble with you, Grey Talon!
(Alt: I don't want any trouble with you, Gary Talon!)
The last thing I wanted was to be on the OSIC's radar...
Glad I got outta that alive.
Can't hide from the light, Haze.
I'll let you decide if that was luck, or skill.
You ain't the law here, Holliday!
There's things in this world that you don't understand, Holliday.
The sheriff will be back, I know it.
I don't need any more fire in my act, sorry.
If you ever wanna work the sideshow, Fern, lemme know.
I had to stop you, Fern!

Why are you workin' with them, Ivy?
I hate that we're fightin', Ivy.

The undead give me the creeps.
I took care of the ice wight.
She was a cutie!.. Evil, but great hair.

You're not gonna hurt my friends, Geist!
Geist is ready to use Oathkeeper!
That’s for what ya did to Lenny in the Bear Pit!
Looks like somebody's past their prime.
I showed Lash how to put on a show.
Don't think he's got a future as an aerialist.

I'd hate to see what sort of experiments she'd run on me…
People that smart are never up to anything good.
You gotta bring more turrets than that to stop us.
I'm not gonna be stopped by a couple of turrets!
She can keep puttin' 'em down all she wants. It's not gonna make a difference.
You're not a very nice person, Mina.
The way you treat people is ugly, Mina.
Just once I'd like to meet a vampire that isn't a jerk.
Love your dress, by the way.
Will you just stop throwing scarabs at people already?!
Mirage takes his job way too seriously.
Sorry about that, Mirage. If you come up to Coney, I'll comp you a ticket.
Ugh, that guy was so uptight!
I still love you guys. Sorry.
People like us were supposed to stick together, Mo.
I'm gonna feel terrible about that later.
You picked the wrong day to come out of the sewer, Mo.
That poor girl is in over her head.
I just want to give her a hug... I mean, not now, obviously, but in general.
The time thief won't be buggin' us for a while.

Sick of those assholes trying to steal my horn...
Can't do better than that, Paradox?!
All ya did was buy a little time, lady.
You're not better than me, Paradox!

I hate dealing with angsty people.
Hey! Us outcasts should be stickin' together.
Hope he doesn't turn on Coney now...
You can't just kill all those people!
I know where you're comin' from, but... you're takin' it too far.
I feel pretty bad about that…

I hope I never see him again…
I hope they lock you away, Seven.

Shiv won't be back for a while.

Sideshow's gonna need a new act.

Almost feel bad about that one.
